# Proto-Nianae
Despite their best efforts, they were not able to get rid of their fire weakness and even with their metallic body parts they still go up in flames like tinder in a tinderbox. They can handle cold a little better, though.
## Racial Features - They can eat cotton, fabrics and clothing as well as most normal foods. - Their blood is [color=#ffa500]copper[/color] based, thus being metabolised from it. - Their blood has a sickly green color. - Their wings give them [color=#1e90ff]50% more acceleration in 0 gravity[/color]. - They are able to jump short distances, allowing them to move around quickly. They can jump up to [color=yellow]3[/color] times in a row, and will regain one 'charge' every [color=yellow]30[/color] seconds. - Due to their thick fuzz they take [color=#1e90ff]60% less Cold damage[/color] and [color=#ffa500]20% more Heat damage. - Additionally their fuzz offers them significant radiation protection, resulting in [color=#1e90ff]50% less radiation damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1e90ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks. - Their standard body heat is 37 degrees Celcius and they [color=#1e90ff]can withstand temperatures between -45 and 45 degrees Celcius[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]350% damage from being set on fire and catch on fire easier[/color]. - They take [color=#1e90ff]50% less cold damage from freezing[/color] and [color=#ffa500]100% more damage from overheating[/color].
## Moffic and Trinary The Nianae language, known as moffic, is composed of a series of chitters. It is often described as sharp and incomprehensible, unable to be spoken by the majority of species without great difficulty. Additionally, Nianae are able to understand mothroaches as they communicate in a similar way to Nianae infants. Like all other Protogens, they are also able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Age and Names Nianae have a slightly shorter lifespan compared to that of humans, reaching adulthood at around 5 years of age and living up to 130. Nianae names are given to them upon reaching adulthood, as they are not consider sentient before then, by their caretakers and commonly include references to fire, light or stars.
